name: player_apply_master_type_transition
description: Player::ApplyMasterTypeTransition resets the primary-gun gate timestamp and dispatches a requested master type to the concrete transition helper.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the coherent Player master-type transition source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42b520 validates ECX as zUtil_SaveGameState*, EDX as the requested master type, flags on the stack, primaryGunGateUntilTime reset from g_Time_AccumulatedTimeSec before dispatch, master-type cases 1 through 5 mapping to Fly, Sub, Track, Hover, and Amphib helpers, the Amphib call passing transitionFlags=0 and the caller flags as extraFlags, and the default return of masterType - 1.
The native smoke verifies the invalid-master default return with the timestamp reset and a valid Fly dispatch path through the concrete helper.
